Name: Infinity Tools
Author: IVanillinI
Description:
[color=#ff00ff]Why does Infinity Weapon exist, but not Infinity Tools? [/color]
[color=#ff00ff]It introduces powerful new tools that can be obtained by visiting the Volcano Summit. [/color]
[color=#ff00ff]Once you reach the Caldera, a cutscene will play with Mr.Qi, who will explain how to upgrade your Iridium Tools. [/color]
[color=#ff00ff]For 3 Galaxy Souls and 75,000g. (customizable) to achieve the final shape of your tools[/color]
[color=#ff00ff]Infinity Tools are better than Iridium Tools, but the default settings don't allow you to break any object with a single hit, but you can customize the values ​​yourself.[/color]

[color=#ff00ff]Tools that can be upgraded:[/color]
[color=#9900ff]Iridium Pickaxe
Iridium Axe
Iridium Hoe
Iridium Watering Can
Iridium Advanced Rod
Iridium Pan
[/color]
[color=#ff00ff]When changing the tool level configuration, be careful, the changes are applied only to the new item,[/color]
[color=#ff00ff]if you received a tool and then changed its level, your old item will not change[/color]

[color=#ff00ff]Recolor support[/color]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21435][color=#ffff00]Vanilla Tweaks[/color][/url]



[color=#d5a6bd]P.S.
I couldn't implement the upgrades through the Volcano Forge because it's impossible to do through CP.
The mod has an issue with pan animation, since CP doesn't allow you to expand the sprite sheet to the right via
"EditImage," so I had to use "Load". This could cause conflicts if you're playing with mods that change the farmer (you can disable animation in the config).
The mod includes a pan-hat, but I also couldn't get it to work like vanilla pan-hats, since the game changes the item's property (pan tool - pan hat in the head slot). It seems impossible to achieve this property through CP either.

If anyone is willing to help me solve these problems, please send me a private message.[/color]
